The ideal candidate will have expertise in AWS infrastructure operations, Windows Server administration, Active Directory, networking, automation, monitoring, and security best practices. eligibility_evidence: Support hybrid connectivity between AWS and Siepe corporate infrastructure, including Meraki SD-WAN, and use PowerShell, Terraform, AI tools, and automation to streamline deployments and infrastructure operations.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have expertise in AWS infrastructure operations, Windows Server administration, Active Directory, networking, automation, monitoring, and security best practices. This is a highly visible, hands-on support role that demands strong operational discipline, effective communication skills, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced financial technology environment. Strong networking expertise across Layer 3 routing, firewalls, VPNs, and SD-WAN, with familiarity with Meraki technologies. Hands-on experience with PowerShell, Terraform, and infrastructure automation, with exposure to DevOps methodologies and CI/CD environments. Experience with AWS cost optimization and cloud governance, with familiarity with SOC 2 Type II controls and compliance requirements.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will design, deploy, and maintain resilient network systems that power Shield AI’s enterprise and development environments—spanning data centers, on-premises sites, and public cloud networks. Provide advanced troubleshooting for network-related hardware, software, and application issues. Configure and maintain secure connectivity services (e.g., VPN/ZTNA, HTTPS, SFTP). Create and maintain clear operational and configuration documentation; mentor operational teams on processes and procedures.
eligibility_evidence: Experience building and managing scalable hybrid infrastructure connectivity solutions linking on-premises systems with cloud networks.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Qualifications: 6+ years of experience supporting and administering complex network systems in production environments. Expertise in network routing, switching, and security architectures. Proficiency in at least one Network Operating System (e.g., NX-OS, JunOS, Arista EOS). Proficiency in at least one Network Security OS (e.g., PAN-OS, FortiOS). Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or 6+ years of relevant experience with a professional certification (e.g., CCNP, JNCIS, VCP-NV, or equivalent). Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with Juniper and Palo Alto network solutions and centralized management platform (Panorama preferred).
